verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for an authenticator product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a developer-facing Authy API/SDK for adding 2FA to third-party apps, which is now closed to new customers. Nothing shows an API exposing the app's own UI functions: token management, device rename/removal, backups, or multi-device settings. Community reports that there is no export option further indicate user data is not programmatically accessible.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
